messages:
nina: Quick ask — can we create a 10-min SI onboarding pack for Datadog + OTLP for Private Marketplace? Needs: smoke command, minimal dashboard JSON, redaction checklist. Who can own?

ddliaison: I can own the Datadog bits (API key scopes, dashboard skeleton, example queries). Will add expected ingestion lag.

alex: Obs team — I can assemble OTLP snippets (v0.50 + v0.60), a tiny attribute-mapping file to prefix rw_ keys, and a one-line smoke curl.

jordan: Security: I9ll write a short PII checklist (fields to delete/truncate) and a required audit grep command to run before sharing samples.

carmen: From SI side: include a 3-step troubleshooting flow and a one-click dashboard import. Also please provide a minimal YAML for collector processors so SIs can paste it in.

alex: Draft smoke (sanitized):
```
# smoke.sh
cat <<EOF | curl -s -X POST ${OTLP_ENDPOINT} -H "Authorization: Bearer ${OTLP_TOKEN}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @-
{"service":"rw-smoke","type":"sanitized","msg":"ok"}
EOF
```
Keep this against canary endpoint only.

jordan: Redaction rules (short): drop keys [user_id,email,session_token]; truncate any free_text >1024 chars; remove Authorization/Cookie headers. Run: `grep -E "(email|ssn|credit)"` on samples before sharing.

ddliaison: Will attach a tiny dashboard JSON and query examples like `avg:rw.si.canary.latency{env:staging}`. Also will document expected tile lag ~20-40s.

carmen: Timeline: Alex assemble pack, Jordan vet security text, DD liaison adds dashboard, I9ll run an SI test on Thursday. Agreed?

deploy-bot: canary deploy success: otlp-pack-staging @ 4060012365 :white_check_mark:

nina: Perfect 12 thanks everyone — post the draft pack here when ready and I9ll route to Partnerships/legal for sign-off.
